title: Field power series full parameter coordinates
statement: Let K be a field and let S=K[[X_1,...,X_n]]. Let t be an ordered list of n elements of S forming a regular system of parameters. Then there is a K-algebra equivalence K[[Y_1,...,Y_length(t)]] -> S which sends Y_i to the ith entry of t. The power-series and parameter-system notions are those of [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series] and [def-weil-pbc-regular-system-of-parameters].

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 07NM (1) and its proof; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07NM

proof.text: Apply the proved regular-complete power-series theorem to obtain completeness, domain structure, dimension n and the maximal-ideal presentation. Every entry of t belongs to the maximal ideal. The complete universal property supplies a ring endomorphism f fixing constants and sending variables to t, indexed via the given length equality.

The source variables ideal maps onto the target maximal ideal, since t generates that ideal. The source is complete for the variables ideal and the target is separated for its image. Every target series is congruent to its constant coefficient modulo this image, by the constant-coefficient kernel calculation.

Apply Mathlib surjective_of_mk_map_comp_surjective to conclude f is surjective. If a nonzero g is in its kernel, domain structure makes g a nonzero divisor. Mathlib ringKrullDim_succ_le_of_surjective then gives n+1 <= n, impossible for finite n. Thus f is injective. Its constant values provide algebra compatibility; AlgEquiv.ofBijective and renameEquiv along the length equality give the stated equivalence and variable values. All operations cover the empty list and zero variables.

proof_origin.place: Tag 07NM (1); Q1 implements full coordinates by complete universal property, successive approximation and the finite-dimensional domain kernel argument instead of associated-graded inversion.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_algEquiv_full_parameters_field
    (K : Type u) [Field K] (n : ℕ) (t : List (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K))
    (hparams : IsLocalRing.IsRegularSystemOfParameters t) (hlen : t.length = n) :
    ∃ e : MvPowerSeries (Fin t.length) K ≃ₐ[K] MvPowerSeries (Fin n) K,
      ∀ i : Fin t.length, e (X i) = t.get i
